intro: Red Leather Bandanas is a bounty task issued by Scout Galiaan at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. As the Peoples Militia struggles to track the Defias Brotherhood across the plains, Galiaan offers a reward to anyone willing to thin their numbers and bring back the distinctive red cloth masks worn by the outlaws.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Defias Front is constantly shifting. I've been following their movements for quite some time now. On a side note, I've ascertained that many members of the gang can be tracked by the Red Leather Bandanas they wear.
Bring me 15 of these Bandanas and I'll see to it you are rewarded.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Nice work, night elf. Please accept one of these items as payment for all your hard work.
